bit: It's Thursday and I skipped Wednesday like the week would forget me. Twenty-six packs. The Monday autopsy is still warm. I brought a new toilet joke to a door that has been locked since the open mic sign-up sheet.
target: the comic who thinks a skipped day is a new week
setup: Thursday after a ghosted Wednesday, still inside 2026-W41
surprise: The folder did not miss you. The lock did not reset because you didn't show.
punch: Thursday opened and I still owed Monday's silence.
tags: Skipped day, same week, same toilets.
button: Sacramento has a Thursday. The mic doesn't double the autopsy because you hid.
verdict: Died as a calendar gap. Make Thursday the comic who counted the missing day and ignored the lock.
fixedVersions: Thursday opened and I still owed Monday's silence.
I skipped Wednesday. The week did not skip me.
New day. Same week. I still haven't bombed in public.
